strings.zh: 茜罗娜『我是茜罗娜,{NEWLINE}是精灵训练师。{SCROLL}来到这个{VAR:FF00:1}神都遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}{NEWLINE}使我想起了{CLEAR}自己的家乡,新奥地区。{SCROLL}一开始还以为这里也是像新奥那样{CLEAR}常年被冰雪所覆盖。{SCROLL}但事实并非如此。{SCROLL}远古时期⋯⋯{NEWLINE}有一批新奥地区人们{CLEAR}移居到这片土地。{SCROLL}他们思念家乡,{NEWLINE}于是就在这里建造了神殿。{SCROLL}那就是{VAR:FF00:1}神都遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: My name is Cynthia. I am a{NEWLINE}Pokémon Trainer.{SCROLL}Coming to the {VAR:FF00:1}Sinjoh Ruins{VAR:FF00:0} reminded me{NEWLINE}of my home, Sinnoh.{SCROLL}At first I thought this place was{NEWLINE}covered in snow all year round,{CLEAR}like Sinnoh.{SCROLL}But that was not it.{SCROLL}A long time ago... people from Sinnoh{NEWLINE}moved to this land.{SCROLL}They missed their home, so they built a{NEWLINE}temple here.{SCROLL}That temple is the {VAR:FF00:1}Sinjoh Ruins{VAR:FF00:0}...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0147/0 | RV050: meaning: US 'must have'/'That's why we call these' not in zh

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『你是⋯⋯{SCROLL}精灵训练师？{SCROLL}从你带着的精灵上{CLEAR}能感觉到强大的力量⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: You are...{CLEAR}a Pokémon Trainer?{SCROLL}I can sense great power from the{NEWLINE}Pokémon you have with you...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0147/1 | RV050: meaning: 从你带着的精灵上 = from your Pokémon, not Poké Ball

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『无法想象你居然凭借{NEWLINE}独自一人的力量能到达这里。{SCROLL}这里一年到头{NEWLINE}都被厚重的积雪覆盖着,{SCROLL}连心都快要冻住的暴雪地带⋯⋯{SCROLL}想回去的话,{NEWLINE}就去跟老爷爷说一声吧。{SCROLL}他会用凯西的力量,{NEWLINE}把你送回原来的地方。
strings.en: Cynthia: I can hardly imagine you made{NEWLINE}it here all on your own.{SCROLL}Thick snow covers this place all year{NEWLINE}round. It’s a blizzard zone cold enough{CLEAR}to freeze your very heart...{SCROLL}If you want to go back, just tell the{NEWLINE}old man. He’ll use Abra’s power to send{CLEAR}you back where you came from.
strings.notes: US 0147/2; modernised from US 0147#2 | RV050: meaning: US 'I wouldn't assume' reversed meaning of 无法想象你居然...能到达这里

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『这个力量的感觉⋯⋯{NEWLINE}帝牙卢卡{CLEAR}帕路奇亚{CLEAR}还有⋯⋯骑拉帝纳？{SCROLL}感觉有些相似但又不太一样⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: The feel of this power...{NEWLINE}Dialga...{CLEAR}Palkia...{CLEAR}and... Giratina?{SCROLL}It’s similar, but not quite the same...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0147/3; modernised from US 0147#3 | RV050: meaning: 还有 = and, not 'or could it be'; 'familiar presence' added

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『你现在有空吗？{SCROLL}一起去{VAR:FF00:1}神都遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}{NEWLINE}看看吧！{SCROLL}如果我的感觉没错的话,{NEWLINE}你和你的精灵{CLEAR}站上那个舞台的时候,{CLEAR}将会发生些什么事。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: Are you free right now?{SCROLL}Let’s go to the {VAR:FF00:1}Sinjoh Ruins{VAR:FF00:0} together!{SCROLL}If my hunch is right, something will{NEWLINE}happen when you and your Pokémon step{CLEAR}onto that stage.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0147/4 | RV050: addition: 'Call it a Trainer's intuition' not in zh; 如果我的感觉没错 restored
empty Cynthia line in the zh (label only); mirrored

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『还真是没想到会{NEWLINE}在被积雪覆盖的{CLEAR}遗迹里相会⋯⋯{SCROLL}改变时间与空间的话,{NEWLINE}人们的生活也会相应地改变。{SCROLL}留下了什么与什么有交集⋯⋯{CLEAR}新奥,城都⋯⋯{CLEAR}即使自以为了解了这世界的一切,{SCROLL}也只是把世界圈禁在自己的框架内{CLEAR}让其毁灭罢了。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: I never imagined we’d meet in{NEWLINE}ruins buried in snow...{SCROLL}When time and space change, people’s{NEWLINE}lives change with them.{CLEAR}What was left behind, and what{CLEAR}crossed paths with what...{SCROLL}Sinnoh, Johto... Even if you believe you{NEWLINE}understand everything in this world,{CLEAR}you’re only locking the world inside{CLEAR}your own frame and letting it die.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0147/6 | RV050: meaning: US line diverged from zh throughout (unused string)

strings.zh: 远古的人们得到精灵的生命,{CLEAR}同时,也将自己的生命托付⋯⋯{CLEAR}与之相应,{CLEAR}人们与精灵建立起了{CLEAR}比现在更为深厚的羁绊。{SCROLL}人们的一举一动{NEWLINE}都与精灵的力量息息相关,{CLEAR}世界各地都流传着{CLEAR}相关的神话和传说。{SCROLL}这片土地上的古代遗迹把{NEWLINE}城都的{VAR:FF00:1}阿鲁夫遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}与{CLEAR}新奥的{VAR:FF00:1}枪之柱{VAR:FF00:0}{CLEAR}{VAR:FF00:1}{VAR:FF00:0}两者的传说{CLEAR}都继承了下来⋯⋯{SCROLL}即是说,在远古时期的这片土地上{NEWLINE}城都的人们与{CLEAR}新奥的人们是{CLEAR}有过交集的。
strings.en: People of ancient times received life{NEWLINE}from Pokémon, and in turn entrusted{CLEAR}their own lives to them... In this{CLEAR}way, people and Pokémon built bonds{CLEAR}far deeper than those of today.{SCROLL}Everything people did was closely{NEWLINE}tied to the power of Pokémon, and{CLEAR}myths and legends about it are{CLEAR}handed down all over the world.{SCROLL}The ancient ruins in this land carry{NEWLINE}on the legends of both Johto’s {VAR:FF00:1}Ruins{CLEAR}of Alph{VAR:FF00:0} and Sinnoh’s {VAR:FF00:1}Spear Pillar{VAR:FF00:0}{VAR:FF00:1}{VAR:FF00:0}...{SCROLL}In other words, in ancient times,{NEWLINE}the people of Johto and the{CLEAR}people of Sinnoh met in this land.
strings.notes: empty {VAR:FF00:1}{VAR:FF00:0} colour pair kept from the zh

strings.zh: 茜罗娜的肉体据说是{NEWLINE}从蛋中诞生的。{SCROLL}在城都,{NEWLINE}精灵的蛋被认为是{CLEAR}孕育生命的容器,{CLEAR}是非常神圣的东西。{SCROLL}相距遥远的土地却有着{NEWLINE}相似的神话{CLEAR}与传说⋯⋯{CLEAR}真是有趣呢~
strings.en: Arceus is said to have emerged{NEWLINE}from an Egg.{SCROLL}In Johto, Pokémon Eggs are believed to{NEWLINE}be vessels that nurture life, and{CLEAR}something very sacred.{SCROLL}Places far from each other can share{NEWLINE}similar myths and legends...{SCROLL}That’s quite interesting, isn’t it?
strings.notes: D-1195: reverted to match the zh (Says Cynthia’s (茜罗娜) body was born from an Egg; vanilla says Arceus (likely a name-replace slip)); logged in hack_findings_import.jsonl | Hack text error fixed with user approval (D-1137, D-1496). | RV050: softened: 非常神圣 = very sacred (D-1721)

strings.zh: 呀~你好！{NEWLINE}又再次见面了呢！{SCROLL}茜罗娜已经回到新奥地区去了！{SCROLL}那个人是新奥联盟的冠军。{CLEAR}忙里抽闲地{CLEAR}进行遗迹的研究。{SCROLL}真是了不起的人啊！
strings.en: Well, hello!{NEWLINE}We meet again!{SCROLL}Cynthia has gone back to Sinnoh.{CLEAR}She is the Sinnoh League Champion.{SCROLL}She studies various ruins despite her{NEWLINE}tight schedule.{SCROLL}How wonderful she is!

strings.zh: 不明原因地来到了这样的地方,{CLEAR}你看来很困惑呢。{SCROLL}想要回家的话,{NEWLINE}那就用凯西的{CLEAR}超能力送你回去吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You seem so out of place, not even{NEWLINE}knowing why you are here.{SCROLL}Do you want my Abra to use a{NEWLINE}special power to take you home? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这样啊~{NEWLINE}那么请在自己的脑海中,{CLEAR}想象一下家乡的样子。{SCROLL}
strings.en: OK... OK... Then please picture your{NEWLINE}hometown in your mind...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0147/11 | RV050: meaning: 家乡 = hometown, not house

strings.en: OK... OK...{NEWLINE}The best of luck to you!
